caption.comprehensive_description: A close-up, high-angle shot captures the process of cooking eggs in a dark, speckled frying pan. Two bright yellow egg yolks are the focal point, resting in a pool of translucent, white egg whites that are beginning to solidify. The yolks are perfectly round and vibrant, contrasting sharply with the pale whites and the dark, textured surface of the pan. The pan itself has a matte, slightly rough finish with small white speckles. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the glossy texture of the yolks and the delicate, web-like structure of the cooking whites. The composition is tight, focusing entirely on the food and the immediate cooking surface.

prominent_elements.name: two egg yolks
prominent_elements.description: Two vibrant, spherical egg yolks that are the central focus of the image.
prominent_elements.appearance_details: The yolks are intact and sit in the center of the whites, showing a slight sheen from the light.
prominent_elements.relationship: They are surrounded by the cooking egg whites and are the primary subject of the scene.

prominent_elements.name: cooking egg whites
prominent_elements.description: The translucent white part of the eggs, spreading out from the yolks and beginning to turn opaque.
prominent_elements.appearance_details: The whites are in various stages of cooking, with some areas appearing more solid and opaque than others.
prominent_elements.relationship: They are contained within the frying pan and surround the egg yolks.
